combinationPolicy.rule: All 51 Type × 2 Breakpoint combinations are represented.

observedFrames.rule: Observed frame dimensions are examples, not numeric breakpoint definitions.

boundTokenGroups.colors: semantic Aurora backgrounds, borders, foregrounds, text, utility and alpha tokens
boundTokenGroups.effects: focus ring and approved shadow tokens
boundTokenGroups.spacing: Aurora spacing tokens from none through large composition values
boundTokenGroups.typography: Aurora text and display scales used according to modal type

rules.note: Do not infer focus trapping, dismissal behavior, escape-key behavior, scroll locking, portal behavior, validation, submit behavior or ARIA semantics unless separately documented.
